config.name: Single pendulum on cart – PID
config.description: Classic cart-pole balanced by one PID loop on the angle. The cart is not regulated, so it slowly drifts – enable the cart loop (or use the LQR-seeded scenario) to hold it in place.

config.name: Single pendulum on cart – angle + cart loops
config.description: Angle loop plus a cart-position loop, robust gains from the auto-tuner (recovers from ≈5 N tip pushes). Note the negative-looking behaviour of the cart loop: to return to the centre the cart first moves away (non-minimum-phase).

config.name: Single pendulum, base motor – PID
config.description: Fixed pivot with a torque motor (reverse-acting PID). Try lowering D to see oscillations, or raising P to see faster, more aggressive recovery.

config.name: Integral windup demonstration
config.description: Large integral gain with a weak motor and anti-windup OFF: the integrator winds up while the output is saturated and causes a large overshoot. Run an experiment, switch anti-windup to 'clamp' or 'back_calculation', run again and compare.

config.name: Double pendulum on cart – multi-loop (LQR seeded)
config.description: Two segments balanced by three parallel loops (cart, θ1, θ2). Robust auto-tuned gains: recovers from tip pushes up to ≈0.5 N (0.1 s).

config.name: Double pendulum, base motor (pendubot) – LQR seeded
config.description: Underactuated: only the lower joint has a motor, yet both segments are balanced through dynamic coupling.

config.name: Triple pendulum on cart – multi-loop (LQR seeded)
config.description: Three segments on a cart. Needs fast, coordinated feedback from all loops; small gain changes quickly destabilise it. Robust auto-tuned gains recover from tip pushes up to ≈0.12 N (0.1 s) – this system is inherently fragile.

config.name: Double pendulum free swing (chaos)
config.description: Frictionless double pendulum without control. Motion is chaotic; the total energy plot stays flat, which validates the integrator.

config.name: Hanging pendulum with joint friction
config.description: Released from 150°, the pendulum swings down to the stable hanging equilibrium (180°) and the oscillation decays due to joint friction.
